text:
The purpose of this session is to adapt the documentation and the tools agents use in further sessions so they do the least effort and consume the least ammount of tokens in order to implement the tasks given in the prompt or in md files.

Create docs and tools, hooks, skills, commands, scripts, and whateder you need, in a harness agnostic manner, so I cand use seamlesly codex, claude, or whatever harness I wish in the future.

Before implementing, read the history of this projects, and the documentation. Then go thru the code base to understand the project. See and note what are the most used commands, scripts, patterns, ideeas. These will become docs, skills hooks, commands, scripts and what you see fit to do your job as best as possible with the least ammount of tokens consumed.

Read the AGENTS.md file and for information that is not needed at every prompt, create a document file inside /docs and refference it this file. Sync AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md so this project can be run in any harness seamlessly.
Keep in mind that this project is harness agnostic. I am working with codex and claude, but in future I want to be able to choose any harness I wish.

Please instruct the agent to write and use skills (for repetitive workflows) when he sees fit, so he can reuse them on future tasks. For skills: a directory under .claude/skills/<skill-name>/ with a SKILL.md file. Include YAML frontmatter for the name and description, followed by concise step-by-step instructions and expected output formats.

Please instruct the agent to write and use hooks and scripts. Write a pre-tool hook configuration so you can reuse in future tasks.

Be thorough and take your time.
